subject: SORT statement
notes: Rule: 'To determine the relative order in which two records are returned from the file referenced by file-name-1, the contents of corresponding key data items are compared according to the rules for comparison of operands in a relation condition, starting with the most significant key data item.' a) ASC lower first, b) DESC higher first, c) equal -> next key (cite.py --check 14.9.40.4 OK, GR8). KeyColumns dispatches on the key's class: numeric -> algebraic via the leaf's own NumProfile (8.8.4.2.4, incl. IEEE float and unsigned 128-bit lanes), national -> decoded national positions under the GR5 national sequence (8.8.4.2.9), boolean -> no sequence (8.8.4.2.8), alphanumeric/group -> byte window under the GR5 alphanumeric sequence (8.8.4.2.7); Compare walks keys in significance order and negates for DESCENDING. a/b/c all pinned by the spec-pinned multi-key test; algebraic numeric by conformance-test:SortMergeDifferentialTests.Sort_SignedNumericKeys_CompareAlgebraically; national by conformance:cases/14.9.24-MERGE/pb678_sort_national_key_collating; float by conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb164_float_sort_key.
